messages:
sana: Heads-up — I'm landing a PR that changes the streaming + paginate examples for the SDK snippets across py/ts/go. Need quick eyes on the examples and a tiny rewrite for the Python iterator pattern. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4121

alex: saw the PR, thanks. The py iterator now yields chunks not full responses — sample should show using async for chunk in stream: and assembling text. I can paste a short snippet.

jin: for Go we also added context+cancel semantics for streaming. Current example in docs misses ctx cancellation and leads to leaks in long tests. I'll add a 3-line patch.

rob: also can we include a short retry/backoff snippet for transient 503s? A lot of customers hit that when batching large requests. Maybe under "Advanced patterns".

alex: quick Python snippet suggestion:```py
async for chunk in client.responses.stream(request):
    if chunk.type == 'delta':
        out.append(chunk.text)
final = ''.join(out)
```
note: use .stream not .streaming in the new SDK.

sana: perfect — that's the exact change. I'll update the docs example to assemble like that and call out the change in the migration note.

jin: Go patch (WIP):```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
// stream.Recv() loop...
```
also mention to handle io.EOF and transient errors separately.

rob: for TS snippet (sync-ish):```ts
const r = client.stream(req)
for await (const ev of r) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') buffer += ev.text
}
```
add a short note about Node10 vs Node18 support for for-await.

docs-bot: PR opened: docs#4121 — reviewers requested: @alex @jin @rob. CI: docs-lint / examples-check queued.

sana: can one of you quickly verify the pagination example still shows cursor param semantics (page_token -> cursor) — I renamed the param but want to be sure we didn't break the code sample.

alex: verified — py and ts samples use cursor now. Go one still had page_token, I'll patch that too.

jin: fixed page_token -> cursor in my branch. Will push in 10m.

rob: added a tiny backoff snippet and a short note about batching impact on latency. Pushed to PR.

sana: amazing — thanks everyone. Once CI passes I'll merge and then follow up with a short blurb in the migration guide (breaking-changes.md) calling out stream iterator + cursor rename.

alex: lgtm after CI. :thumbsup:

jin: :shipit:

rob: thanks, will ping support so they can update any internal runbooks.

sana: closing loop — I'll merge after tests. If anything else pops up ping me in thread. :)
